PICTURE cells: ONE item or scene seen exactly straight on (or from directly above), filling the cell, flat even light, no readable text or logos. CUTOUT-style PICTURE cells say "on plain pure white background": draw only the object, centred, on flat pure white with no shadow. Tiles are flat, evenly lit and seamless.
